description: The line plot illustrates the performance of four variants of the DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) model, measured by Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10), as a function of the number of queries used during inference (S), ranging from 1 to 10. The x-axis, labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S),” is linearly scaled with integer tick marks at each value from 1 to 10. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10,” spans from 33.0 to 36.0 in increments of 0.5. Four distinct lines represent different DPR configurations: “DPR w/o query” (black solid line) remains constant at approximately 34.2 across all S values; “DPR w/ corpus expansion” (red line with circle markers) starts at ~35.1 when S=1, rises to ~35.7 at S=6, and plateaus near 35.8 for S=8 to 10; “DPR w/ document expansion” (green line with triangle markers) begins at ~34.7, peaks at ~34.9 at S=6, then slightly declines to ~34.7 at S=10; and “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion” (blue line with star markers) starts at ~34.7, peaks at ~34.9 at S=3, then steadily declines to ~34.4 at S=10. A gray square legend marker appears in the top-left corner but is not associated with any plotted line.
